summary.text: Tom Cowhick is the Republican candidate for the Colorado House of Representatives, District 9, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces Democrat Monica VanBuskirk.
He previously lost to incumbent Emily Sirota in the 2022 and 2024 general elections for the same seat.
